title: Pure Dragunity
summary: Pure Dragunity Winged Beast and Dragon Synchro strategy utilizing the classic equip-and-summon mechanic alongside the Glorious Gallery support wave and generic staples. Led by one-card starter Dragunity Remus and Dragon Ravine, the deck equips Dragon Tuners like Phalanx and Couse to Winged Beasts, climbs rapidly into high-Level Synchros, and locks opponent interactions with Dragunity Lord - Georgius.

summary.title: Starters
points: Dragunity Remus discards itself from hand to search Dragon Ravine from Deck to hand, and Special Summons itself from the GY as a Level 2 Tuner while you control a Dragunity monster.
Dragon Ravine discards 1 card to search a Level 4 or lower Dragunity monster from your Deck or send any Dragon monster from Deck to GY.
Dragunity Quirinus on Normal or Special Summon searches any Dragunity Spell or Trap from Deck to hand, and swaps a Dragunity on field for one in hand.
Dragunity Legatus Special Summons itself from hand while you control Dragon Ravine or a Dragunity monster, and destroys a Spell/Trap on field while a Dragunity is equipped.
Dragunity Falchion banishes itself from hand to equip a Dragunity Dragon monster directly from your Deck to a Dragunity you control.

summary.title: Opening: Dragunity Remus
steps: Discard Dragunity Remus to search Dragon Ravine from your Deck.
Activate Dragon Ravine, discarding a card to search Dragunity Quirinus (or Dragunity Legatus) from your Deck.
Normal Summon Dragunity Quirinus and search Dragunity Glow from your Deck.
Activate Dragunity Glow to search Dragunity Arma Mystletainn, then activate Remus in the GY to Special Summon itself to the field.
Synchro Summon Dragunity Knight - Gae Dearg using Quirinus and Remus, activating Gae Dearg to add and discard a Dragon or Winged Beast.
Climb through Dragunity Knight - Barcha and Romulus into Dragunity Knight - Areadbhair or Dragunity Lord - Georgius.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Dragunity Lord - Georgius is a Link-4 boss that completely locks the opponent from activating monster effects in the GY, Special Summons a Level 5+ Dragunity when the opponent summons, and negates opponent Spells/Traps.
Dragunity Knight - Areadbhair is a Level 10 Synchro that banishes a Dragunity monster from your GY as a Quick Effect to negate an opponent's monster effect and banish that monster.
Dragunity Knight - Ascalon banishes a Dragunity monster from your GY to banish an opponent's monster, and floats into a Dragunity Synchro with 3000 or less ATK upon destruction.
Dragunity Knight - Areus negates opponent cards on field up to the number of Monster Cards in your Spell & Trap Zones.
Dragunity Knight - Trident sends up to 3 cards you control to the GY to send that many cards from the opponent's Extra Deck to the GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Dragunity Divine Wind returns a Dragon or Winged Beast you control to the hand to Special Summon a Dragunity monster from your Deck and equip it with a Dragunity Dragon.
Dragunity Glow searches a Level 5 or higher Dragunity monster, and banishes itself from the GY to Special Summon an equipped monster card.
Dragunity Oubliette is a Counter Trap that negates an opponent's Spell or Trap activation while you control a Dragunity Synchro Monster.
Dragunity Divine Lance equips from hand to boost ATK by 100 x Level, grant Trap immunity, and equip a Dragon Dragunity Tuner directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Outside engine pieces like Mist Valley Baby Roc, Blackwing - Zephyros the Elite, Tempest, and Bystial Dis Pater are omitted to ensure a pure Dragunity build.
